title: She stands …
content:
So back she goes to her old ways,

 of fending for herself,

defending for herself,

laughing at herself,

crying by herself,

shutting everything and

everyone out,

hurt them before they hurt her.

She may have not known real joy or happiness

before but now she is stripped off of

any hope.

Jesus Christ was her one last hope and she

did everything with her faith firm in this

relationship, 

being firm to love someone

broken and invalid, 

loving despite her brokenness and incapacity.

Now all that is gone.

And she stands… 

to bear the burden

to stand against him and

strip him of the power of love she

once surrendered happily and willingly
